SELECT surv_man_no , surv_no , member_id , member_name , FIND_CODENAME(surv_answer) AS surv_answer , FIND_CODENAME(account_type) AS account_type FROM survey_people WHERE surv_man_no = #{survManNo}

SELECT surv_man_no , surv_no , member_id , member_name , FIND_CODENAME(surv_answer) AS surv_answer , FIND_CODENAME(account_type) AS account_type FROM survey_people WHERE surv_no = #{survNo} AND member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT COUNT(surv_man_no) FROM survey_people WHERE surv_answer = 'E402' AND surv_no = #{survNo}
SELECT DISTINCT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM survey_people) AS surv_total , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM survey_people WHERE surv_answer = 'E402') AS surv_response FROM survey_people WHERE surv_no = #{survNo}

SELECT all_cnt AS "allCnt" , stu_cnt AS "stuCnt" , par_cnt AS "parCnt" , all_res_cnt AS "allResCnt" , stu_res_cnt AS "stuResCnt" , par_res_cnt AS "parResCnt" , (CASE WHEN all_cnt = 0 THEN 0 ELSE all_res_cnt / all_cnt * 100 END) AS "allPercent" , (CASE WHEN stu_cnt = 0 THEN 0 ELSE stu_res_cnt / stu_cnt * 100 END) AS "stuPercent" , (CASE WHEN par_cnt = 0 THEN 0 ELSE par_res_cnt / par_cnt * 100 END) AS "parPercent" FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS all_cnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN account_type = 'E501' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS stu_cnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN account_type = 'E502' THEN 1 ELSE null END) AS par_cnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN surv_answer = 'E402' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS all_res_cnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN account_type = 'E501' AND surv_answer = 'E402' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS stu_res_cnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN account_type = 'E502' AND surv_answer = 'E402' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS par_res_cnt FROM survey_people WHERE surv_no = #{survNo} ) s
